reviewed_upstream.observation: QymCAD booleans are a thin Rust wrapper over a native C ABI returning Option/Result shapes.
Fillet/chamfer requests are represented as a typed ask; the construction is native.
Offset/thicken requests are typed asks; no local construction algorithm is present.

rationale: The editing adapter is new code against the pinned OCCT 8.0.1 API (BRepAlgoAPI_*, BRepFilletAPI_*, BRepOffsetAPI_*, BRepBuilderAPI_Sewing/ShapeFix). QymCAD's boolean/blend/shell modules are thin typed asks over a native C ABI with a different naming system, so no code is copied; only the ABI idea (typed request in, complete result out) is aligned.

QymCAD native C ABI: the adapters are our own in crates/om9-kernel/src/editing_bridge.cpp.
